name: JamAI Base | AI Spreadsheet Backend with RAG and Agents
description: Spreadsheet-style AI pipelines: LLM columns, RAG and chat agents
card_desc: JamAI Base: build AI pipelines as spreadsheets. Columns run LLMs, code and RAG over your documents; Knowledge, Action and Chat tables with an API and SDKs. Bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter keys. Password gate, Postgres, ClickHouse, MinIO included.
